svg.title: Purple and Yellow: the theme on the camera, Q, Settings and the viewer
svg.desc: Mockups of one theme of issue 138 on four screens. The picture, the thumbnail and the photo in the viewer are never tinted. The Not Signed warning keeps its amber; on a theme other than Standard it is a filled amber chip with black words and an outline in the text color, so it reads on any background. Sketches of layout and color, not pixel-exact screens. Ratios are calculated with the WCAG 2.2 formula, not measured.
